tools.name: bing_list_accounts

tools.name: bing_get_insights
tools.title: bing get insights
tools.description: Submit an asynchronous Microsoft Advertising report for the selected account and return a receipt. Poll the receipt with bing_get_report. Column compatibility and sandbox data availability apply.

accountId.description: Account ID listed in BING_ADS_ACCOUNT_IDS. Use the numeric ID, not the eight-character account number shown in the web app.

reportType.description: Native report type. Each type supports its own columns; see bing_get_reporting_schema.

aggregation.description: Daily returns one row per day. Summary returns period totals; omit TimePeriod from columns to avoid splitting rows.

reportTimeZone.description: Native Microsoft reporting time zone. Omit it to keep Microsoft's default.

returnOnlyCompleteData.description: True makes Microsoft return an error instead of a report while data for the requested period is still being processed.

campaignId.description: Optional campaign ID to scope the report. Not supported by account reports.

since.description: First day of the report, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive.

until.description: Last day of the report, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on or after since.

columns.description: Native report columns compatible with reportType; see bing_get_reporting_schema.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

tools.name: bing_get_report
tools.title: bing get report
tools.description: Poll and download a report submitted by bing_get_insights for the same account. Returns up to 2,000 CSV rows as strings; narrow the range when truncated is true. Empty sandbox output is not production evidence.

accountId.description: Account ID listed in BING_ADS_ACCOUNT_IDS. Use the numeric ID, not the eight-character account number shown in the web app.

receipt.description: Receipt returned by bing_get_insights in this server session. It expires after one hour.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

campaignType.description: Native type of campaignId, used to verify that it belongs to the account. Dynamic Search campaigns use Search with DynamicSearchAdsSetting.

criterionType.description: Write category: Targets for demographics, location and devices; Audience for audience associations. Reads use the specific criterion type.

data.description: Native Microsoft Advertising REST fields for this entity. Read bing_get_write_schema first. REST Type values can differ from SOAP class names. Microsoft checks eligibility only on a confirmed call.

confirm.description: False returns a local preview and sends nothing. True applies this exact change, after the user approved it.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.
